name: Vlc
tagline: A free and open source cross-platform multimedia player and framework that delivers dependable performance across multiple devices.
description: VLC Media Player is a free and open source cross-platform multimedia player and framework that delivers dependable performance across multiple devices.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/vlc:3.0.24@sha256:47fa90ac456cc9485e28ec7bccbedc56cedaab87853237461374c12fb91c588c
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
      VLC_CLI: ''
    ports:
      - target: 3000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 3001
        published: 3001
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
